scope: Product opt-in CONNECT-only recovery in disposable HID/FTDI guests: ordinary real I/O, one SIGKILL/actual wait137, background helper restores the exact original baseline and retires the old grants before any pending API or new grant, then third real I/O. No test USBFS recovery actor, administrator bind/reconcile, FD revocation or hardware claim.
